# NovaDent Ağız ve Diş Sağlığı Polikliniği (NovaDent Dental Clinic)

> NovaDent Ağız ve Diş Sağlığı Polikliniği is a modern dental polyclinic in Maslak, Istanbul, Turkey. Licensed by the Republic of Turkey Ministry of Health as an authorized International Health Tourism institution.

## Overview
- **Clinic Name:** NovaDent Ağız ve Diş Sağlığı Polikliniği
- **Official Website:** https://sametcolak.com.tr/Novadent/
- **Phone:** +90 212 555 01 23
- **Email:** info@novadentclinic.com
- **WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/905551234567
- **Address:** Büyükdere Cad. No:142 Maslak, Sarıyer / İstanbul, Turkey (3 minutes walking distance from ITU Ayazaga Metro Station)
- **Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate No:** DEMO-2026-TURIZM-4143 (Concept / Portfolio Prototype)
- **Working Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 09:00 – 19:00 (Sunday: Emergency & VIP appointments on duty)

## Core Dental Treatments & Specialties
- **Dental Implants & Oral Surgery:** Permanent titanium implants, immediate loading, bone grafting, sinus lifting, wisdom tooth extractions.
- **Invisalign & Orthodontics:** Clear aligner therapy without braces, 3D intraoral digital scanners, pediatric & adult orthodontics.
- **Hollywood Smile Makeover & Cosmetic Dentistry:** Ultra-thin E-Max laminate veneers, digital smile design (DSD), natural aesthetic smile restorations.
- **Zirconia & Porcelain Crowns:** High translucency monolithic zirconia and porcelain crowns for durability and lifelike aesthetics.
- **Pediatric Dentistry (Pedodonti):** Specialized child dentistry, milk teeth restorations, space maintainers, trauma management, and friendly approach.
- **Laser Teeth Whitening (Bleaching):** In-office dental laser whitening, clearing enamel stains up to 7 shades in a single 45-minute session.
- **Periodontology:** Gum disease treatment, gingivectomy, deep scaling, root planing, and aesthetic pink gum contouring.
- **Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics):** Rotary file endodontics, pain-free nerve treatment, restoration of compromised teeth.

## Medical Staff & Dentists
- **Dr. Kerem Yıldız:** Managing Dentist & Aesthetic Dental Surgeon (Specializing in Implants, Full Mouth Reconstruction, and Smile Makeovers)
- **Dr. Caner Tekin:** Aesthetic Dentist & Prosthodontist (Specializing in E-Max Laminate Veneers, Zirconia, and Digital Dentistry)
- **Dr. Selin Aksoy:** Pediatric Dentist (Pedodonti) & Preventive Care Specialist
- **Dr. Mert Özkan:** Orthodontics & Clear Aligners Specialist (Invisalign)

## Technology & Infrastructure
- 3D Digital Intraoral Scanners (Impression-free digital workflow)
- Digital Panoramic & Cephalometric X-Ray imaging
- Class-B Autoclave multi-stage sterilization protocols
- Single-use barrier protection for every patient

## International Patient Care
- Multilingual consultations in Turkish, English, and Arabic
- T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı official authorization
- Direct WhatsApp triage and treatment planning
